title: BeachCrest 504 | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: BeachCrest 504 is a 2.00 bedroom, 2.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Come once and make this 5th floor condo your favorite vacation destination! This stunning condo offers 2 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, comfortably accommodating up to 6 guests. Enjoy breathtaking, direct Gulf front views right from your living room. BeachCrest 504 is a perfect blend of traditional and modern furnishings, complemented by colorful and whimsical artwork, creating a fun and eclectic environment. With fresh updates and the beautiful Gulf of Mexico as your backdrop, you couldn't ask for a more perfect beach retreat.Relax in the cozy living room with a 55" TV, or step out onto the balcony to enjoy the ocean views. The kitchen is fully equipped with a blender, toaster, and coffee maker, perfect for whipping up a beach picnic or a special vacation meal. The master bedroom features a luxurious king bed, TV, and private bath. The queen guest bedroom offers easy access to the full hall bath. Plus, there's a washer and dryer for your convenience.Sleeping Arrangements:Bedroom 1: King bed, tv, balcony access, private bath with walk in shower and vanity.Bedroom 2: Queen bed, shared bathroom with vanity.BeachCrestYou'll feel on top of the world in this mid-rise condominium that hugs the Seagrove shoreline, offering private beach access. Ideally located along Scenic Highway 30A in Seagrove Beach, BeachCrest is just minutes from Seaside, Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach. You’ll find no shortage of options for shopping, dining, and entertainment.This well-kept 12-story building offers Gulf-front accommodations with one of the best views across all of 30A. Some of the many amenities include natural gas grills, picnic tables, a grassy play area, and Gulf-front pool that is heated seasonally.Your stay at BeachCrest 504 comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Gulf-Front Pool: Heated Nov. 1-May 1.* Complimentary beach service: 2 chairs/1 umbrella set up Mar. 1-Oct. 31 (weather permitting)* Parking for 2 cars* Sorry, no pets allowed* BeachCrest is a smoke-free and tobacco-free property.*** Disclaimer: Please note that elevator door and mechanism upgrades are currently in progress and are now projected to continue through the end of March. Work will be completed one elevator at a time, which may result in slightly longer elevator wait times and occasional noise. These improvements are being completed to enhance the building for future stays. Thank you for your understanding. ***An initial starter kit of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
